actions.text: Act One, pianissimo. A service door off the Burgring clicks shut behind Ottilie Graf; gaslight ticks, the parquet smells of beeswax, and three floors up a string quartet is tuning to an A she could hum in her sleep. Somewhere above those strings, in a room lined with felt, a bird that has not sung since 1899 waits in brown wax. Mirela is already at the cloakroom, tapping her watch.
